parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'assinado') AS assinados, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'enviado') AS pendentes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'recusado') AS recusados, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (data_assinatura - data_envio)) / 3600.0) FILTER (WHERE status = 'assinado'), 1) AS taxa_media_horas FROM assinaturas WHERE DATE(data_envio) = CURRENT_DATE;
